text_block_list.name: Hello & Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
It's delicious!
It's really delicious!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "It's completely transformed from last time! The noodles, soup, and toppings unite in a trinity, creating a flawless harmony!"
choice_data_list: This... this is the best soy sauce ramen ever...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "It's completely transformed from last time! The noodles, soup, and toppings unite in a trinity, creating a flawless harmony!"
choice_data_list: My whole concept of miso ramen has been completely overturned...
My whole concept of miso ramen has been completely overturned...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "It's completely transformed from last time! The noodles, soup, and toppings unite in a trinity, creating a flawless harmony!"
choice_data_list: I want to eat this salt ramen for the rest of my life!!

text_block_list.text:
It's not just the luxurious toppings. The flavor has such depth...
How did they make this ramen?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh♪ It's simple, really.
We brought together all the skills we've cultivated!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: With earnest dedication, Top Road-san spent hours perfecting this soup!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Using her trademark speed,
Calstone preps the ingredients and locks in the flavor!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
With all her local love, Nature-chan
customizes the seasoning to each customer's taste!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
With Doto-chan's attentiveness, she adds the toppings!
Wiping away the little broth splashes on the bowls until they sparkle—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-chan brought us all together
with her leadership!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Niigata. Fukushima. Nagoya. Kokura. Hokkaido.
We've mobilized every ounce of technique
we've honed across the nation. This is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: “—The ultimate bowl! Here it is!”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Her condition certainly lives up to the name!
All that's left now is to await race day!
choice_data_list: We need to get fired up and get ready too!
We need to get fired up and get ready, too!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! If we serve this ramen,
everyone will be even more hyped than expected!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Beyond my expectations...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's what we need to do...
—Then, one more thing. A little something extra...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um! Excuse me! Aside from
ramen, there's something else I'd like to do!"

And so, the day of the
"Super Ramen Jamboree Kiwami" arrived—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming today! It's quite crowded right now, so please line up along this queue to enter!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, so many kindred spirits!" "Can't wait!"
"I made sure to come on an empty stomach!" "Seconds for me!"
"Nature!" "Class Rep!" "Straightaway!"
choice_data_list: Please move all the way forward!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah! It's so lively! There's a huge line
even before opening—you can really feel everyone's excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Right! ...In the middle of all this, I'm so sorry! My suggestion caused such a frantic rush for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It was a wonderful idea!
I'm so glad we might be able to make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I just received word... Everything is going according to plan.
It seems preparations at the other venues are in top shape too!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to wait for the opening of the
'Super Ramen Jamboree Ultimate'! Now, let us begin!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone, are you ready!?
Here goes the usual!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm gonna do it. This is the last chance!
Even I've gotta pull it off eventually!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Here we go, then!
One, two—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ramen!!
